item.title: Moderate Cannabis Use May Protect the Aging Brain
item.description: A massive study of over 26,000 middle aged and older adults reveals that those who use cannabis in moderation have larger brain volumes and sharper cognitive skills than non-users.

item.title: Finding the “Goldilocks” Speed for AI-Powered Artificial Limbs
item.description: New research reveals that for an AI-powered robotic arm to feel like part of your own body, it has to move at a very specific, human-like speed.

item.title: Identifying the Neural Link Between Hearing Loss and Dementia
item.description: Scientists have discovered the biological "bridge" that explains why hearing loss leads to cognitive decline—and how it changes the very structure of our brains.

item.title: Study Links Sugary Drinks to Adolescent Anxiety
item.description: We know sugar is bad for the body, but what about the mind? A new study finds a troubling link between sugary drinks and the rising tide of anxiety in young people.

item.title: Early Life Diets Quietly Shape IQ Years Later
item.description: New research shows that a toddler's diet can predict their IQ in elementary school, and ultra processed foods are the primary culprit.

item.title: Why Some People Are Naturally Better at Detecting AI Images
item.description: Think you can spot a deepfake? It might have nothing to do with your computer skills. A new study shows that your natural ability to recognize objects is the secret to seeing through AI.

item.title: Brain Imaging Study Reveals Cannabis Impact on Working Memory
item.description: Your brain’s "mental workspace" might be taking a hit. The largest cannabis brain-imaging study ever conducted shows a significant decline in working memory for heavy users.

item.title: Delivery Method of Probiotic Flips the Brain Between Memory and Mood
item.description: Memory or Mood? Your choice of probiotic might depend on the packaging. New research reveals that how probiotics are prepared dictates whether they help your focus or your feelings.

item.title: Two Genetic “Hits” Required to Trigger Parkinson’s Neurodegeneration
item.description: Researchers find that a mutation in GBA1 must be paired with an ATP13A2 mutation to drive the neurodegeneration seen in Parkinson’s disease.

item.title: Musical Robot: Combining AI Speech and Song to Combat Loneliness
item.description: Researchers find that combining music and empathetic speech makes social robots significantly more effective at bonding with humans and reducing loneliness.
